eyebrow: SQL Dialects: T-SQL, PL/SQL, MySQL & Beyond · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 53 · Cloud Warehouse SQL Dialects

code:
-- T-SQL
SELECT TOP 10 ProductName, ListPrice FROM Production.Product
ORDER BY ListPrice DESC;

-- Snowflake
SELECT product_name, list_price FROM production.product
ORDER BY list_price DESC
LIMIT 10;
caption: Snowflake has no TOP — it uses LIMIT, like PostgreSQL and MySQL.

code:
-- T-SQL
SELECT FirstName + ' ' + LastName AS FullName

-- Snowflake
SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name
caption: The ANSI-standard concatenation operator, not T-SQL's overloaded +.
Unquoted identifiers fold to UPPERCASE internally, like Oracle.

code:
SELECT customer_id, order_id,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
                      ORDER BY order_date DESC) AS rn
FROM orders
QUALIFY rn = 1;
caption: Filters directly on a window function — no wrapping CTE needed.
